source_claim: AlphaEvolve can use LLM-generated feedback to grade properties that are difficult to capture precisely in the evaluator, such as simplicity, and can use those grades as scores or discard gates
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve can declare configured LLM feedback graders, qualitative criterion metadata, criterion descriptions, evaluator-gap rationales, rubric or prompt hashes, score-or-discard intent, metric linkage, calibration-report-id metadata, bounded qualitative policy records, observed feedback record counts, and prompt-history feedback joins. It does not claim executed calibration task suites, criterion-quality ablations, hard-to-code property fixtures, or independent feedback-quality validation.
